data.name: Praveen
data.gender_notes: Praveen is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit pravīṇa, 'skilful, expert'. Its root is Sanskrit pravīṇa (प्रवीण). A classical Sanskrit term for skill. Praveen is a Sanskrit name meaning “Skilful; expert; proficient”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Praveen expresses “Skilful; expert; proficient”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Praveen total 36, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
